reviews.t: Happy Costumer here. The product is Authentic!
reviews.x: I've previously owned one of these Durags that had torn due to normal wear and tear. I went to several local beauty supply stores trying to find it again, as this was the best Durag I had ever owned. Anyone with a good wave pattern HATES the line that the seam puts in the middle of his/her head. After reading the reviews I was a bit skeptical if this would truly be the same product I once owned. However, I can assure you that it is. I am completely satisfied.

reviews.t: The Seller advertised one product and sells you another.
reviews.x: I am sick and tired of falling victim of false advertising. I ordered the Wave Builder Seamless Du-Rag Black; instead I received a cheap Du-rag that I could have bought from the store. The Seamless Du-Rag is hard to find, unless you live in the city. Therefore I bought it online. It's not worth it to send it back. It's just going to lay in my draw and eventually end up in the trash. Total waste of my money!

I use this to prevent frizz on my curly hair while I sleep. It is comfortable, sufficiently cool so that it won't make my scalp sweat and stays put all night long, even though I move around a lot while I sleep.  My wife loves how it looks, so that's a bonus.

This can be solved by throwing on a wavecap though so its all good. Overall this

reviews.t: won't stay on when I'm asleep
reviews.x: After shaving my head for 15 years, I've started growing my hair out again. Even though I'm Asian, my natural hair is so I keep waking up with my hair hopelessly, painfully tangled. An African-American co-worker recommended I sleep with a du-rag. Unfortunately, it keeps slipping off in my sleep, no matter how tightly I tie it.

It is a large rag, which I imagine is good for someone with a lot of hair. For me, the rag works best when wearing overnight. It isn't like my other rag, which set my waves after taking a morning shower in about 30 minutes.
The durag does what its supposed to do, now i got these waves all around my head makes me feel good every time my girlfriend wants to rub them.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the durag works well for protecting hair and maintaining waves, with several reporting fast results.
Several reviewers complain the product is not seamless as advertised, noting visible seams.
Multiple reviewers report receiving a different brand than expected (not Wave Builder) or the wrong item entirely.
Reviewers frequently praise the low price and value, with some buying multiple packs.
A few reviewers mention shipping and packaging problems, including late delivery and an opened package.
